75
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 10, 2005/Sravana 19, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development;
Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Dispute between Nagas and
Manipuris
*241. SHRI RAJ NATH SINGH: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) how Government plan to sort out
the social and territorial problems between
the Nagas and the Manipuris in the State
of Manipur;
(b) whether Government are planning
to involve the different ethnic groups and
the political parties of Manipur to solve
this burning issue; and
(c) whether Government have any blue
print to sort out this issue?
Development of textile industry in
Assam
*242. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state the details
of steps being taken by Government for
rapid development and promotion of textile
industry in the State of Assam?
Use of numbers on dollar currency as
codes by militants in J&K
*243. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the reports about the use of
numbers on million dollar currency bills as
code by militants for their nefarious
activities in Kashmir Valley; and
(b) if so, Government's response and
reaction thereto?
Rape cases registered in the country
*244. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of rape cases
registered in India, during 2004, with State-
wise break-up;
(b) the number of rapes per lac of
population in India, with State-wise break-
up;
(c) in the light of above statistics, which

76
were the first five States, where rape
scenario was most alarming; and
(d) the steps Government intend to take
to improve the situation?
Recruitment in Delhi Police
†*245. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
recruitment of nearly 15 thousand
constables including women constables
would be made in Delhi Police;
(b) if so, the number of lady constables
out of them; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Potable water for fluoride affected
districts of AP
*246. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government had earmarked
Rs. 208 crore for supply of potable water
for fluoride-affected districts of Andhra
Pradesh; and
(b) if so, the amount earmarked for each
district in Andhra Pradesh?
Provision made under R.G.G.V.Y.
†*247. SHRI DARA SINGH
CHAUHAN: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state:
(a) the amount  earmarked under the
Rajiv Gandhi Grameen Vidyutikaran Yojana
togetherwith targets fixed therefor;
(b) the amount sanctioned/likely to be
sanctioned to Uttar Pradesh for the years
2005-2006 and 2006-07 under the above
yojana;
(c) whether Government have identified
those districts of eastern Uttar Pradesh
where rural electrification is quite low in
comparison to national average;
(d) if so, district-wise details thereof;
and the number of villages targeted to be
electrified under the above yojana; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Roads under PMGSY
*248. PROF. M.M. AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of roads in the rural areas
in States particularly in the State of Uttar
Pradesh being constructed under the
Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana, State-
wise/Road-wise; and
(b) the total funds allotted and utilised
for the construction of these roads during
the last three years, State-wise?
Parking facilities in NDMC area
*249. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that despite
Supreme Court direction to N.D.M.C. to
improve the parking facilities in Lutyen's
Delhi, the N.D.M.C. has failed miserably
to improve the construction of spacious
Palika Parking at Connaught Place and has
not commenced work on multilevel parking
projects;
(b) if so, the reasons for this inordinate
delay; and

(c) by when the work on these
multilevel Parking projects is likely to be
commenced and completed?
Power projects sanctioned for J&K
*250. SHRI T.S. BAJWA: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) how many power projects have been
sanctioned for Jammu and Kashmir;
(b) how much funds have been
proposed for the same and the details of
the funds spent on each power project;
(c) what is the present status of these
projects; and
(d) how many people of Jammu and
Kashmir have been employed by these
projects?
Liberalisation of visa rules for foreign
students
†*251. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether keeping in view the fact that
foreign students are extr

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 10, 2005/Sravana 19, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development;
Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
Price of Indian coffee
1729. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the price of
Indian coffee has doubled during the last 6
to 8 months;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the high
international prices give a chance for the
Indian coffee industry to boost its export;
(d) if so, the likely export of coffee to
different countries during the current year; and
(e) the income likely to be generated
from this?
 Effect of lifting quantitative ban on
import of consumer commodities
†1730. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are going to lift the quantitative ban
imposed on the import of consumer
commodities;
(b) whether Government are aware of
the fact that by the said action domestic
production of consumer commodities will
get a setback; and
(c) if so, the details of steps taken by
Government for the development of the
domestic industry?
 Trade negotiations under Doha
Round in Paris
1731. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has sent any
team to attend the special session of
Ministerial Council Meeting of the
Organization for Economic Cooperation
and Development on "Trade Negotiations
under the Doha Round in Paris" recently;
(b) if so, the composition of the team
thereof;
(c) the details of the meetings held in
this regard;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

393
(d) the outcome thereof; and
(e) the details of the expenditure
incurred for the said visit?
 Special Coffee Term Loan for Coffee
growers of Karnataka
1732. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) how many Coffee growers in
Karnataka have taken the benefit under
Special Coffee Term Loan;
(b) whether it has come to the notice of
Government that now the Coffee growers
have been asked to repay three years
interest;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) since the Coffee growers in
Karnataka are in great distress whether
there is any representation from the
Karnataka Government to extend the
period for repayment of interest under this
scheme upto March, 2006?
 Fall in Shrimp export after Tsunami
1733. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether export of Shrimps has
declined considerably, especially after
Tsunami disaster; and
(b) if so, what action has been taken to
increase the export of Shrimp?
 Promotion of export of leather
1734. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have identified the leather industry as a
thrust sector in view of significant export
growth prospects and enormous
employment potential particularly in semi-
urban and rural areas;
(b) whether it  is also a fact that
Government have decided to capture at least
five per cent of World Trade in leather
within the next five years; and
(c) if so, the details of the steps taken in
this regard?
 Floriculture production and export
1735. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
develop floriculture production and export
them from the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the measures being taken by
Government for enhancing production and
export of flowers from Tamil Nadu?
 Restoration of free access to Indian
goods by US
1736. DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether US has restored free access
to goods from India, citing improved
intellectual property rights;
(b) if so, whether according to US, India
has made progress in providing an effective
protection of intellectual property rights;
(c) if so, what is the full list of the duty
free items or the value of access that has
been made available to Indian goods;

394
(d) whether Indian exports of about $1
billion received duty free access or reduced
duty benefits for entry to US market under
the programme till 1990-92; and
(e) if so, whether Indo-US trade has
grown significantly then and if so, to what
extent this decision of US will further
improve US-Indo trade?
